findings.claim: Gartner 2Q26 庫存指標跌入中度短缺，AI 半導體需求推動，預期此趨勢持續至 2027。
findings.excerpt: In 2Q26, the GIISST fell 8.5% into moderate shortage, driven by strong AI semiconductor demand. This trend is expected to persist through 2027

findings.claim: TrendForce：NAND 2026 年供給短缺 4-5%，2027 下半年供給位元成長將超過需求成長。
findings.source: TrendForce via itiger: NAND Flash Supply Shortage Expected to Ease in Second Half of 2027
findings.excerpt: supply will fall short of demand by 4-5% in 2026, but by the second half of 2027, the growth in supply bits will outpace demand growth

findings.claim: JPMorgan 預期供給限制持續，2028 年初前無顯著產能增加；BofA 預期 2028 仍偏緊，並提示 2027 中為轉折點。
findings.excerpt: JPMorgan considers that supply constraints will remain in force and estimates there will be no significant increases in production capacity before the beginning of 2028

findings.claim: Rambus Q3 2026 管理層：客戶較早下 backlog 訂單、2027 需求預期轉強，但上下半年季節性仍在；Q4 營收指引 227-233 百萬美元。
findings.source: MarketBeat: Rambus Q3 earnings call highlights
